verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev stores run data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for it. However, no evidence item documents retention periods, purge or deletion of runs or logs, or any related setting. Self-hosting's 'full control over your environment' is an adjacent host-side arrangement, not a product retention or deletion feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
